MORE INFO: Israel has shared intelligence with the US indicating that Iran is developing chemical weapons for potential use against Israel and other countries in the region, Defense Minister Israel Katz told reporters. He also confirmed that the IDF and U.S. Central Command have prepared plans for a joint strike on Iran. Chemical weapons. Katz said Iran sees chemical weapons as a potential “game-changer.” Israel has had the intelligence for some time, and its assessment is that Iran would use the weapons if it acquired them. Katz said Israel is determined to prevent that and must verify whether Iran has begun production. How urgent is the threat? “If we thought this was already an imminent event, we would have acted,” Katz said. The nuclear program. Katz said Iran is working to revive its nuclear program. In Israel’s assessment, a chemical arsenal could deter Israel and other countries from intervening, giving Tehran more room to advance its nuclear work. Joint strike plans. Katz said plans for a joint operation are ready and the decision rests with President Trump. Israel prefers to coordinate with Washington but can strike independently if necessary. Katz said he, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the IDF chief of staff agree on that position. Trump considered a strike before Israel’s elections. According to Katz, Netanyahu told Trump that Israel wanted to avoid a strike before the vote. Trump later called it off. Katz said Trump also weighs the views of regional partners, energy interests and the prospects for an agreement with Iran. Iran could strike first. Katz acknowledged the risk of a preemptive Iranian attack and said Israel must be prepared to strike even under those circumstances. Threats on U.S. soil. Katz accused Iran of actively working to assassinate Trump and harm other senior U.S. officials inside the United States. Iran’s missile launchers. Katz linked the timing of any Israeli action to the difficulty of defending against Iranian fire. “The sooner we act to eliminate Iran’s missile-launch capabilities, the easier our defensive mission will be.”

Israeli occupation forces use people as human shields in southern Lebanon, a Haaretz investigation reveals. An Israeli soldier tells the paper that troops sent a person into a building during an invasion to cross the Litani River, after a dog from the army's Oketz canine unit was wounded inside. A military source says the practice was repeated a month later in the same area, and a person was killed in an explosion. The investigation also reveals that the army has opened at least 16 criminal investigations since October 2023 into soldiers using Palestinian civilians as human shields, 10 in Gaza and six in the occupied West Bank. Soldiers call the practice the "mosquito protocol." Not one soldier or officer has been prosecuted.

Vijay govt files review petition over SC nod to light lamp at Thiruparankundram hill The Missionary government has challenged the Supreme Court's one-time permission to light the Karthigai Deepam at Thiruparankundram. The dispute has raised law-and-order… Christian Missionary Vijay's TVK government defies supreme court The Tamil Nadu government today lit the Karthigai Deepam at the traditional location near the Uchi Pillaiyar temple on the Thiruparankundram hill in Madurai, but not at the hilltop stone pillar next to a Dargah, as permitted by the Supreme Court as a one-time event in an interim order.
